title: Generator Künneth calculation agrees with evaluation
statement: Use the finite-field datum, $A=A_{E,n}$ and the actual operations of [sk-def-sf-operations] on separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Let $h_i:S_i\hookrightarrow Y_i$ be locally closed immersions, let $F_i$ be lisse sheaves of finite projective $A$-modules on $S_i$, and let $L_i\in D^b_{ctf}(Y_i,A)$. Put $E_i=Rh_{i!}F_i$, $F_i^\vee=R\mathcal Hom(F_i,A)$, $T_i=F_i^\vee\otimes^LRh_i^!L_i$, $h=h_1\times h_2$, $F=F_1\boxtimes F_2$, $L=L_1\boxtimes L_2$. Use the tensor–Hom comparison [sk-thm-sf-tensor-hom] and finite-projective evaluation to identify $R\mathcal Hom(E_i,L_i)$ with $Rh_{i*}T_i$. Then the following composite is the evaluation-defined $\beta$ of [sk-def-sf-kv-maps](iii): apply the canonical ordinary product comparison in the first factor to $Rh_{1*}T_1\boxtimes Rh_{2*}T_2$, then in the second factor to $T_1\boxtimes Rh_{2*}T_2$, use ordinary direct-image composition to obtain $Rh_*(T_1\boxtimes T_2)$, apply $Rh_*(1_{F^\vee}\otimes\alpha_{h_1,h_2})$, and identify the result with $R\mathcal Hom(Rh_!F,L)=R\mathcal Hom(E_1\boxtimes E_2,L)$ by tensor–Hom and Ku_!. The assertion is equality of maps; it does not assume or conclude invertibility of $\alpha$ or $\beta$.
